description: This file contains the implementation of the Orleans.Serialization.SystemTextJson namespace, including the JsonCodec class for JSON serialization/deserialization, options configuration, and extension methods for serializer registration.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A codec class for JSON serialization and deserialization within Orleans, implementing multiple interfaces for general serialization, cloning, and type filtering.

classes.name: JsonCodecOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the JsonCodec, including serialization, copying, and reader/writer settings.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods to add JSON serialization support to the Orleans serializer builder.

methods.name: AddJsonSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add JSON serializer with custom type filters and options to the serializer builder.
